prompt:
You are a senior machine-learning reviewer evaluating a TMLR manuscript. This is a fresh, zero-context review. Read the complete LaTeX manuscript and compiled PDF directly, including appendices, tables, figures, and bibliography. Do not inspect prior review rounds, improvement logs/state, Git history, implementation code, or experiment outputs. Do not open paper/f3_tmlr/table_real48.tex. Do not run any code, experiments, or access data; in particular do not open the protected confirmation block (seeds 5303...) or the sealed group civic_records_sealed. The paper text may be read, including discussion of seed ranges.

Review claim calibration in both directions, theory/assumptions, evidence alignment, clarity, self-containedness, notation, citations (do not browse), and visual presentation. Preserve unfavorable evidence. Flag unsupported claims and required writing-only fixes. Do not ask for new experiments as a prerequisite; list any needed evidence separately as open. Assess every PDF page visually, including appendices.

Read directly: main.tex, main.pdf, refs.bib, math_commands.tex, all included table source files under tables/, and included figure wrappers/exports under figures/. Return a complete structured review: score (1-10; 6 weak accept, 7 accept), verdict (Ready / Almost / No), summary, ranked strengths, ranked CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR weaknesses with exact locations and actionable writing fixes, missing references if any, page-specific visual review, and whether complete scope was reviewed. Do not report model identity unless runtime exposes it.
